mechanisms.description: Presto.TIME_MAPPING aliases unrelated MySQL.TIME_MAPPING; derived mappings and tries affect consumers without MySQL receiver calls.
FUNCTION_BY_NAME is built from class sql_names during import. An alias collision redirects parsing into the edited class from tests that never previously invoked that class.
Dialect metaclass copies tokenizer quote/identifier delimiters; Generator uses dialect values without requiring tokenization.

mutations.name: mysql_mapping
mutations.patch:
diff --git a/sqlglot/dialects/mysql.py b/sqlglot/dialects/mysql.py
--- a/sqlglot/dialects/mysql.py
+++ b/sqlglot/dialects/mysql.py
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@
 
     # https://prestodb.io/docs/current/functions/datetime.html#mysql-date-functions
     TIME_MAPPING = {
-        "%M": "%B",
+        "%M": "%m",
         "%c": "%-m",
         "%e": "%-d",
         "%h": "%I",

mutations.name: registry_alias
tokenizer_identifiers
mutations.patch:
diff --git a/sqlglot/dialects/bigquery.py b/sqlglot/dialects/bigquery.py
--- a/sqlglot/dialects/bigquery.py
+++ b/sqlglot/dialects/bigquery.py
@@ -151,7 +151,7 @@
         DROP_UNKNOWN_ESCAPES = True
         QUOTES = ["'", '"', '"""', "'''"]
         COMMENTS = ["--", "#", ("/*", "*/")]
-        IDENTIFIERS = ["`"]
+        IDENTIFIERS = ['"']
         IDENTIFIER_ESCAPES = ["\\"]
         STRING_ESCAPES = ["\\"]

environment_recheck.reason: venv PATH correction for sole bare-executable subprocess test; full-suite result retained for all other tests
